sloka: ततो ऽश्मनगरं नाम कालकेयैरधिष्ठितम् ।गत्वा तु कालकेयांश्च हत्वा तत्र बलोत्कटान् ।। ७.२३.१७ ॥
transliteration: tato 'śmanagaraṁ nāma kālakeyairadhiṣṭhitam ।gatvā tu kālakeyāṁśca hatvā tatra balotkaṭān ।। 7.23.17 ॥

translations.english: Then, having gone to the city named Ashmanagara, which was inhabited by the Kalakeyas, Ravana killed the exceedingly strong Kalakeyas there.
